categories.name: Quality Management
categories.text: Dimensional data from instruments and CMMs, ballooned drawings, inspection reports and calibration alerts. Deviation is visible before the batch is closed.

categories.name: Production Monitoring
categories.text: Job cards, poka-yoke on job setup, production data capture, machine-wise OEE and energy. Availability, performance and quality on the same board.

categories.name: Inventory
categories.text: Tools, jigs, fixtures, spares, consumables and gauges. Issue and return against operator or production order, with usage by machine, shift and part.

categories.name: Process Planning
categories.text: Process charts, machine availability, scheduling, production review and rescheduling when priorities change. Digitized production orders instead of a compiled pack.

solutions.title: Gauge Management Software
solutions.text: Register every gauge with identity, location and due date. Alerts fire before calibration is missed, so a gauge past date is not still on the machine.

solutions.title: Quality Status – INDi4.0 Basic
solutions.text: Capture process quality against set limits and notify deviations. First-off and in-process results sit on the job, not on a sheet entered after the bin has moved.

solutions.title: Quality Status – INDi4.0 Basic + SPC
solutions.text: The same quality capture, with control charts and process capability on the characteristics already being inspected.

solutions.title: Digitisation of Testing Labs
solutions.text: Dimensional measurement for IPID monitoring. Data from measuring instruments and CMMs, and the inspection report generated from the same entry.

solutions.title: INDIQ 4.0 – AI Manufacturing Intelligence
solutions.text: Ballooned drawing, extracted characteristics, CMM/VMS program and the final inspection report in one loop, so the checklist is not typed from a paper print.

solutions.title: Digitisation of Job Cards
solutions.text: Job card display: when the card is received or scanned, the operator sees the interlinked documents. Routing and sign-off stay with the job.

solutions.title: Tool Room Inventory Management
solutions.text: Register tools, jigs and fixtures. Record issue and return against operator or production order. Usage by machine, shift and part number, with remaining life at issue.

solutions.title: Order Management App for Top Management
solutions.text: Digitized production orders. Supervisors review and approve the plan; leadership sees open orders, promised dates and dispatch without waiting for a compiled file.

solutions.title: Project Management App
solutions.text: Risk mitigation and rescheduling when the machine schedule changes. Internal tasks, owners and dates sit next to the production plan.

solutions.title: 3D Viewer
solutions.text: Process visualization on the shop PC. Open the model with the job without a CAD seat on every terminal.
